title: Nathan Smith:
title_short: Nathan Smith (CEO) · People Just Need a Chance
headline: CASS's CEO says homelessness is not only the person on the street corner. It is families who lost a job, and what they need is a chance.
story: Nathan came to CASS and saw that people experiencing homelessness take their opportunities too. They want a shot.
Most people don't know CASS runs a family shelter. Many of those families were barely getting by, lost a job, and had to hit the streets with their kids.
A woman at The Haven, with a case manager, found work and her own housing. People just need a chance.
